title: Looks Nice
text: Looks Nice. This is a basic twin comforter. The description says it's "ultra soft", but I don't think it feels very soft at all. It's not rough to the touch either, but it's not what I would consider soft. The planets look nice. It's more of a realistic space depiction rather than cutesy. The quality seems to be okay, but it has the over all look and feel of an inexpensive comforter.
